integrity: The full-NRD property is established by exhaustive exact integer cross-products over all applicable finite upper-set comparisons; the NRTD violation is an exact rational inequality. No random search or numerical tolerance is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The result proves existence of a seven-positive-atom full-NRD/non-NRTD law inside the minimal 2-by-2-by-3 rectangle. It does not prove that seven is the minimum possible support size and does not classify all sparse witnesses.
title: Seven atoms suffice for full-NRD failure of right-tail dependence
